chat.headerSubtitle: Ask me about your personal information
chat.welcomeNoDocs:
Hello! I'm Moments, your personal memory assistant. I'm here to help you remember important details from your life.

To get started, please upload a document (like a diary, care plan, or notes) so I can help answer your questions.

What would you like to know?
chat.welcomeWithDocs:
I'm Moments, your personal memory assistant. I'm here to help you remember important details from your life.

I can help you with questions about:
• Family members and relationships
• Important dates and celebrations
• Health information and medications
• Daily routines and schedule
• Where you live and important places

What would you like to know today?
